name: foundry-dev
postStartCommand:
if ! grep -qs 'MISE_FNOX_BOOTSTRAP' /root/.bashrc; then printf '
# MISE_FNOX_BOOTSTRAP (mise+fnox)
export MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise
export FNOX_STATE_DIR=/workspaces/.fnox-state
mise trust /workspaces/foundry-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
eval "$(mise activate bash)" 2>/dev/null || true
eval "$(fnox activate bash)" 2>/dev/null || true
' >> /root/.bashrc; fi; (cd /workspaces/foundry-dev && MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise mise install >/dev/null 2>&1) || true; MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise mise use -g fnox@latest >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ -f /workspaces/.secrets/azure-sp.env ] && ! az account show > /dev/null 2>&1; then . /workspaces/.secrets/azure-sp.env && az login --service-principal -u "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" -p "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" -t "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
